technology_name: NIR Photovoltaic Power Delivery for Implantable Devices
model: uncertainty -> experiment -> information gained -> technical decision -> capital avoided/unlocked (directive section 17)
dominant_uncertainty: Whether the recorded optical-to-electrical power chain survives a physical tissue-equivalent path at thermally safe source power. The simulation chain is now ARCHIVED and hash-pinned (VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE/, R404) and the historical 1050-vs-121 uW contradiction is RESOLVED (same fluence, different area/efficiency assumptions) — but the entire chain remains simulation-only, the canonical deliverable power is UNKNOWN (eta unknown), and the D2 engineering gap (500 uW target vs 121-163 uW conditional band) is an open owner decision.
